brief: Rename variable `tmp` to `scratch_dir` in scripts/cleanup.py and update its two call sites.
Sort imports and remove unused ones in src/jev_poc/client.py using ruff.
Summarize the contents of docs/architecture.md into five bullet points.
Fix the off-by-one in paginate(): the last page is dropped when total % page_size == 0. Add a regression test.
Implement retry with exponential backoff for the Jev HTTP call in client.py, honoring JEV_TIMEOUT_S.
Refactor hooks/jev_risk_gate.py to extract the verdict-to-output mapping into a tested function.
Add a new Score question type to the tier router for task complexity 0-2.
Write unit tests for shadow.py append/read_all covering corrupt lines.
Design the auth model for multi-tenant skill execution: per-tenant API keys, key rotation, audit.
Diagnose the intermittent deadlock between the hook subprocess and the PTY reader under concurrent tool calls.
Propose a migration from fail-open to fail-closed for the risk gate in regulated tenants, with break-glass.
Review the threat model of sending tool-call text to a third-party decision API; propose mitigations.
Debug why updatedInput.model is ignored for Task calls in one project but honored in another.
Update the README wiring section after testing the hooks on Windows.
Fix flaky test in tests/test_logic.py that depends on dict ordering.
Add docstrings to every public function in src/jev_poc.
Evaluate whether Jev Choice confidence is calibrated on our tier fixtures; propose a recalibration.
